name: Single-Leg Box Jump
steps: Stand facing a low sturdy box balanced firmly on one foot with your opposite foot lifted slightly off the floor.
Hinge briefly into a shallow quarter squat while swinging your arms back to load your standing leg.
Drive explosively upward through your standing leg and swing your arms forward to leap cleanly onto the box.
Land quietly and stably on the same single foot, stand tall, step down carefully, and switch legs after completing one side.
tips: Keep your landing knee aligned squarely over your middle toes without letting it cave inward.
Use a conservative box height that lets you stick every single-leg landing under complete balance.
